lede: A magnitude 5.5 quake near Hamakita, Japan was the day's clearest cross-feed signal: it rode the top of Google's US trending searches as "japan earthquakes" while USGS logged it alongside a larger 5.8 out on the central Mid-Atlantic Ridge. Two topics surfaced on more than one feed outright, Godzilla Minus Zero, live on both Wikipedia and YouTube ahead of its final trailer, and James Talarico's 2028 presidential odds, which Polymarket still prices near 1 percent even as his Wikipedia page drew a crowd. On Wikipedia itself, Ramayana: Part 1 led everything with 785,245 views, roughly 1.5 times the runner-up, and nothing in the snapshot explains why. The rest of the day was elections, more earthquakes, and the season's first Christmas playlists.
